name: A Pitched Game
source:
Apollo, a firefly, has had his boyfriend kidnapped and placed into the hotel and was once the base for a cult that worships the lack of light, darkness itself. He goes to save him.

[From [url=https://davidthezettanerd.itch.io/a-pitched-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿波罗是一只萤火虫，他的男朋友被绑架并被安置在酒店里，它曾经是一个崇拜光明和黑暗本身的邪教的基地。他去救他。

[来自[url=https://davidthezettanerd.itch.io/a-pitched-game]Itch.io[/url]]
